reference_time_note: Mixed-method perimeter dated 2026-02-27, date-current 2026-03-01; relationship to final extent and exact segment observation times unresolved. Post window begins at containment; overlap is descriptive only.
selection_rule: Within each window rank by proximity to fire (latest pre, earliest post), then scene ID; shortlist four with tile cloud <=60% and full AOI footprint. Pick the pair with maximum joint SCL-valid AOI coverage, ties by shortlist order. Never use dNBR or reference overlap for selection.
threshold_rationale: Freeze the existing prototype's dNBR >=0.1 and pre-NBR >=0.1 rules before reading these satellite pixels; also report plain dNBR >=0.1. No threshold tuning on this inspected case.
